title: AI Development of Unified Field Theory from Geometric First Principles: Spiral Emergence and Testable Predictions

contributions.purpose: 由 AI 从几何第一性原理构建统一场论并宣称恢复标准物理
contributions.mechanism: 三维螺旋参数化 R(t)=(R0 e^{b0t}cos wt, R0 e^{b0t}sin wt, ct)+变分法推场方程,取极限得 Maxwell/Einstein 方程
contributions.evaluation: 无实验;仅形式推导,声称电磁极限恢复 Maxwell 波动方程、引力极限恢复 Einstein 场方程
contributions.domain: 理论物理(非主流统一场论)
contributions.source_quote: The AI independently transformed Zhang XiangQian's spatial motion insight into a comprehensive framework that... Reproduces established physics (Maxwell, Einstein, Schrodinger equations) as limiting cases

contributions.purpose: 把基本物理常数导出为无量纲几何比值
contributions.mechanism: 由螺旋作用量与自相似(黄金比)约束推 h0=pi、G0=1/pi、alpha0=1/pi^2,再用量纲'缩放因子'桥接物理值
contributions.evaluation: 理论 alpha^-1=pi^2~9.87 vs CODATA 137.036,靠 scaling factor~13.9 弥合;粒子质量比与 phi 匹配偏差 0.1-0.3%
contributions.source_quote: The AI-generated framework derives fundamental constants as dimensionless geometric ratios (h0 = pi, G0 = 1/pi, alpha0 = 1/pi^2), predicts universal beat frequencies, golden ratio relationships in particle masses, and novel mass-charge coupling.

contributions.purpose: 给出可检验预言与证伪判据
contributions.mechanism: 预测普适拍频 T_beat~5361 次振荡、phi^n 能量比处截面增强、质量-电荷耦合,并配光钟/Penning 阱/LHC 实验协议与 5 sigma 判据
contributions.evaluation: 均为未来实验预案(1-10 年时间线),本文无任何已执行的验证
contributions.source_quote: The theory generates specific testable predictions including T_beat ~ 5361 oscillations in precision timing, enhanced cross-sections at phi^n energy ratios, and correlated fundamental constant variations.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Starting from Zhang XiangQian's foundational insight that space moves in a spiral at light speed, we developed a unified field theory where all physical phenomena emerge from three-dimensional helical geometry.

Unlike Einstein's dynamic spacetime shaped by matter, this framework posits that spatial motion is ontologically primary, with time, mass, charge, and energy emerging as manifestations of directional unfolding in three-dimensional spiral geometry.

notes: 非实证理论物理论文(fringe/民科系,基于 Zhang XiangQian 非主流理论,参考文献含 'Xinjiang Iron and Steel' 期刊),四元组 evaluation 格无真实实验数据,只能记形式推导与未来实验预案,协议适配较差。关键数字问题:精细结构常数理论值 pi^2~9.87 与实验 137.036 相差约 14 倍,用临时'scaling factor S_alpha~13.9'弥合;质量比 phi 匹配(0.1-0.3% 偏差)属事后数字拟合。checklist:AI 参与度五项全 [C](AI 独立发展理论/设计实验/分析/写作,人类仅顾问);statistical significance 答 Yes 但指的是对未来实验的 5sigma 要求而非本文数据;experimental reproducibility 答 Yes 实为公式可复算。无编号贡献列表,按 conclusion 4 条归纳压缩为 3 条。
